verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Chroma publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (openapi.json) and getting-started docs with code examples. Nothing documents an interactive API reference, a 'try it' console, or runnable in-browser examples. The OpenAPI file is a building block from which such a reference could be built, so it is adjacent and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
